subject: Application - Platform Engineer - Acme
body:
Hello, I hope you are doing well.

I am applying for the Platform Engineer role at Acme.

- Platform work: I build and operate data platforms on AWS with Terraform, CloudFormation and CI/CD.
- Automation: I turn the repetitive part of the work into self-service tooling for the teams I support.

My production experience is on AWS, so the platform and automation side transfers directly to your stack.

I look forward to hearing from you. Best regards,
